code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Locate the full-width or full-height separator.
    row_sep = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0), None)
    col_sep = next((c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != 0), None)
    if row_sep is not None and row_sep > 0 and row_sep < h - 1:
        a, b = grid[:row_sep], grid[row_sep + 1:]
        assert len(a) == len(b) and all(len(x) == len(y) for x, y in zip(a, b))
        return [[2 if x != 0 and y != 0 else 0 for x, y in zip(ar, br)] for ar, br in zip(a, b)]
    if col_sep is not None and col_sep > 0 and col_sep < w - 1:
        return [[2 if grid[r][c] != 0 and grid[r][c + col_sep + 1] != 0 else 0
                 for c in range(col_sep)] for r in range(h)]
    raise ValueError('No centered separator found')
'''
